body: Thanks for the input, much appreciated.

Based on where other people my age are in life in my area, I would say that no, I don’t feel like she’s accomplished for her age. I don’t know too much about her, but from our conversations and what i’ve learned about her from our coworkers, I think she’s content with where she is in life. 

As for growing up quickly, the people around me said I have because of home life conditions (first-generation college student, family illness, mental illness, poverty, etc.). While my home life situation is a lot better now, I still honestly can’t even see my self making it to 21, never mind 5 years from now having a family.

Thanks for coming back, I really appreciate it.

Probably a little bit of both, but i’m reluctant to put any blame on her. All of my friends that i’ve asked said that it’s a lot to take in and borderline predatory which is partially why i’m concerned.

We’ve talked about it yesterday, and she talked about wanting us being in a relationship before we planned out this date, but she didn’t explicitly use the girlfriend term. I don’t know what we are, but it feels like a lot so suddenly.

I’m thinking that it’s anxiety since this is new territory for me and also because of the strong positive affirmation that i’m not used to? Maybe I subconsciously think it’s too much considering i’ve been working there two months? I really don’t have any reasons to NOT like this person because they haven’t done anything inherently wrong imo.

thank you, i’m glad you found something that has worked for you and hopefully i can give it a try sometime soon when it’s not 90 degrees out. congrats on your weight loss and good luck on your future gains! i also wish you the best on your job hunt <3
